limitations: This audit checks recorded JSON receipt consistency and source phase wiring; it does not independently reexecute native/browser operations.
The independent F32 artifact arithmetic, artifact byte hashes and Git blob/source hashes are assigned to parent.
Cancellation cancelReply lacks its own embedded target; exact-target cancellation is corroborated by source owner.invocationTarget(candidate) call plus the recorded terminal queue entry.
Postpublication refresh logic is inspected statically and all six actual decisions pass. This record does not contain a separate actual late-binding-change rejection trial.
No full model inference, complete adapter coverage, universal input support, generation readiness, OS/device/full-model resource budget or N-ARTIFACT package acceptance is claimed.
